introZh: 请先在文稿框中写出译文，再点「核对」比对 keys.rtf；也可直接「显示答案」。

part1.titleZh: 练习一 · 译成中文（或你使用的语言）
part1.hintZh: 昆雅 → 目标语；对照词汇表与正文例句。

items.prompt: Man marnë i coassë cainen loar yá, írë inyë lá marnë tassë?
items.answerKey: Who lived [or, "dwelt"] in the house ten years ago, when I did not live in it?
items.answerZh: keys：Who lived [or, "dwelt"] in the house ten years ago, when I did not live in it?

items.prompt: Áta antat nin, ar ávata nurtat nillo!
items.answerKey: Give it to me, and don't hide it from me! (The ending -t in antat, nurtat indicates that only one person is addressed.)
items.answerZh: keys：Give it to me, and don't hide it from me! (The ending -t in antat, nurtat indicates that only one person is addressed.)

items.prompt: Man elyë cennë i otsëa auressë?
items.answerKey: Who did you see on the seventh day?
items.answerZh: keys：Who did you see on the seventh day?

items.prompt: Antuvantë ilyë i annar inyen ar lá elyen!
items.answerKey: They will give all the gifts to me and not to you!
items.answerZh: keys：They will give all the gifts to me and not to you!

items.prompt: Mana i neri hirner i nóressë i oronti pella?
items.answerKey: What did the men find in the land beyond the mountains?
items.answerZh: keys：What did the men find in the land beyond the mountains?

items.prompt: Manen elyë poluva orta i alta ondo írë inyë úmë polë caritas?
items.answerKey: How will you be able to lift the great stone when I could not do it?
items.answerZh: keys：How will you be able to lift the great stone when I could not do it?

items.prompt: Sellelma marë coa entassë; elmë marir i toltëa coassë mallë sinassë. Á tulil ar á cenil coalma!
items.answerKey: Our sister lives in that (yonder) house; we live in the eighth house in this street. Come and see our house! (Á tulil ar á cenil = "come and see"; the ending -l indicates that several people are being addressed.)
items.answerZh: keys：Our sister lives in that (yonder) house; we live in the eighth house in this street. Come and see our house! (Á tulil ar á cenil = "come and see"; the ending -l indicates that several people are being addressed.)

part2.hintZh: 目标语 → 昆雅；注意复数、冠词 i、词序。

items.prompt: What did you find in the seventh room when you went there [or, "thither" = tanna]?
items.answerKey: Mana elyë hirnë i otsëa sambessë írë lendel(yë) tanna?
items.answerZh: keys：Mana elyë hirnë i otsëa sambessë írë lendel(yë) tanna?

items.prompt: When you have come, I want to leave [auta].
items.answerKey: Írë elyë utúlië, inyë merë auta! (If elyë can function as a plural pronoun and it is interpreted as a plural "you" here, the verb should perhaps also be plural: elyë utúlier.)
items.answerZh: keys：Írë elyë utúlië, inyë merë auta! (If elyë can function as a plural pronoun and it is interpreted as a plural "you" here, the verb should perhaps also be plural: elyë utúlier.)

items.prompt: Give us the wine! (an order explicitly addressed to several persons).
Give the wine to us and not [lá] to the warriors! ("Us" is exclusive here. "To" = dative, not allative. This order is explicitly addressed to one person only.)
items.answerKey: Á antat i limpë elmen ar lá i ohtarin!
items.answerZh: keys：Á antat i limpë elmen ar lá i ohtarin!

items.prompt: The seventh warrior has come from beyond the great mountains.
items.answerKey: I otsëa ohtar utúlië i altë orontillon (or, -llor) pella.
items.answerZh: keys：I otsëa ohtar utúlië i altë orontillon (or, -llor) pella.

items.prompt: Beyond [or, behind] the eighth door [or, "gate", ando] you found a great treasure; we [exclusive] who came after you [apa le] did not find a thing!
items.answerKey: I toltëa ando pella elyë hirnë alta harma; elmë i tuller apa le úmer hirë [or, lá hirner] engwë! (Alternatively elyë hirner if the pronoun is taken as plural; cf. Exercise K above. Notice that the "who" of the relative sentence "we who came" is translated by means of the relative pronoun i: The word man denotes a different kind of "who", used in actual questions.)
items.answerZh: keys：I toltëa ando pella elyë hirnë alta harma; elmë i tuller apa le úmer hirë [or, lá hirner] engwë! (Alternatively elyë hirner if the pronoun is taken as plural; cf. Exercise K above. Notice that the "who" of the relative sentence "we who came" is translated by means of the relative pronoun i: The word man denotes a different kind of "who", used in actual questions.)

items.prompt: How did the evil Dwarves find them seven days ago?
items.answerKey: Manen i úmië Naucor hirner te [or, te-hirner] otso auri yá?
items.answerZh: keys：Manen i úmië Naucor hirner te [or, te-hirner] otso auri yá?
